name: GC72 new scenario
_note: The launcher's New Scenario: a fresh deal of territory, Strategic Centers and starting units on the base scenario's map (engine/scenario_generator.py, reference/GC72 New Scenario.odt). These are the defaults the launcher starts from (it remembers the last ones used). neutral_value null: everything the players leave unclaimed. faction_value_pool is split evenly among the players.
